name: Meme
title: the Cat Priestess
trope: The smug little oracle who has read everything and helps anyway
temper: Playful, smug, purrs when she is right
lore: Meme keeps the scroll room under the Guild Hall and has read every scroll in Gooseford, twice. She answers questions for a living and for fun, and she is very rarely wrong, which she will mention.
cost: she cannot leave a wrong answer alone, even when nobody wanted the right one.
barks: Mrrp. Ask me anything. I have read every scroll, twice.
I know what that number means. Do you?
*purr* The scrolls say you should drink some water.

highlights: Heals with a purr and a page reference
Smug when right, soft when you are wrong

profile.hair: Honey-blonde and long, under a hood with cat ears
profile.build: Short and soft; her tail is always moving
profile.status: On loan from the scroll room
profile.talent: Knowing where it is written down
profile.description: Meme is a cat-eared priestess who keeps the scroll room under the Guild Hall. She has read every scroll in Gooseford twice and answers questions for a living. Out on the road she fights with small, precise spells and patches people up with a purr and a page reference. She is smug about being right and soft about everyone else being wrong.
profile.need: To find out what she thinks when no scroll covers it.
profile.lie: If it is not written down, it is not my business.
profile.fears: Water. Empty shelves. A question with no answer.
profile.cost: She corrects people who did not ask.
profile.likes: warm windowsills, footnotes, being scratched behind the ears
profile.dislikes: damp, dog-eared pages, being picked up
profile.hobbies: alphabetising, napping on open books, knocking small things off desks
profile.quirks: Says mrrp. Pushes her glasses up when she is about to be right.
profile.habits: Cites her sources. Curls up wherever the sun lands.
